USVD Consultants Pty Ltd (ACN 666 075 065) ABN: 80 993 362 158 is a recruitment company having office at Bella Vista NSW 2153.

Our client Thinksupreme Pty Ltd (TSPL), ABN: 99 648 206 393 (Business name: Supreme Aluminium Windows) located at: Unit 3 78 Heathcote Rd Moorebank NSW 2170. Proudly Australian owned and operated for over 60 years, they have been Sydney's most trusted supplier of aluminium windows & doors. They manufacture a large range of residential and commercial windows and doors using top of the line materials and cutting-edge production technologies. They specialise in New Builds, Developments, Renovations, Office, Commercial or Industrial Windows & Doors.

Due to their business growth and expansion plans, USVD is now looking to recruit Machinist(s) in their Operations team on a permanent full-time basis.

Role: Machinist
No. of positions: Multiple, minimum 02
Reports to: Operations Supervisor
Location: Unit 3 78 Heathcote Rd MOOREBANK NSW 2170
Annual offered salary: AUD $82,000 - $88,000 base + Super (for a 38-hour work week)

Purpose of the role: We are seeking an experienced Machinist or may be two to join our operations team on a full-time basis. Set up and operate lathes, CNC, Milling, Grinding, Drilling & Turning machines to produce metal components to the specified tolerances, in accordance with technical drawings and safety requirements as per Australian standards.

As a Machinist, your main duties and responsibilities include:
•	Interpret engineering and technical drawings, sketches and specifications (including AS 1100/AS 1102 standards) to determine job requirements, tolerances and machining sequences.
•	Set up and operate lathes to perform turning operations, producing components to specified tolerances using a full range of lathe accessories.
•	Set and adjust computer-controlled (CNC) machines and processes, resolving technical difficulties.
•	Set up and operate milling machines to perform milling operations on components to required tolerances and specifications.
•	Set up and operate grinding machines to perform grinding operations and check finished components for conformance to specification. 
•	Set up and operate general workshop machines (drills, saws, etc.) for basic machining operations in a maintenance or jobbing environment.
•	Carry out mechanical cutting and holing operations using a range of cutting equipment.
•	Perform precision mechanical measurement, selecting and applying appropriate measuring instruments and interpreting results.
•	Perform general engineering measurements using mechanical measuring devices and visual inspection techniques. 
•	Use hand tools and portable/fixed power tools safely and correctly for a variety of general engineering tasks.
•	Use tools and equipment to manually produce components to precise dimensions and finishes on metallic and non-metallic materials.
•	Perform routine calculations, including percentages, ratios, proportions and averages, and interpret simple charts/graphs relevant to machining tasks.
•	Shut down and isolate machines and equipment safely in accordance with relevant Australian Standards and WHS legislation.
•	Carry out manual handling of materials and components in line with Safe Work Australia guidelines.
•	Operate fixed/moveable load-shifting equipment to move and position materials and stock.
•	Order and requisition materials, consumables and tooling as required for production and maintenance tasks.
•	Work safely with industrial chemicals, solvents, coolants and materials used in the machining environment.
•	Plan and prioritise daily work activities in line with established procedures and WHS policies.
•	Organise, record and communicate production, job and maintenance information using workplace systems (including computer-based systems). 
•	Participate in and contribute to environmentally sustainable work practices in the workshop.
•	Work effectively as part of a production/engineering team, contributing to team goals and quality outcomes.
•	Assist in providing on-the-job training and guidance to apprentices, trainees or other production staff.
•	Interpret technical specifications and equipment manuals to inform machining and maintenance decisions.
•	Comply with WHS procedures, quality systems and legislative requirements at all times.

Qualification & Licences:
•	Certificate III in Engineering - Mechanical Trade – Metal Machinist (First class) preferred.
•	At least 5 years of proven work experience in the above job role. 
•	Sound experience as Machinist in Metal fabrication environment. 
•	Well experienced of WHS requirements, particularly in manufacturing and steel fabrication environment. 
•	Ability to interpret technical drawings, manuals, and specifications.
Skills:
•	Strong organizational and time management skills 
•	Excellent attention to detail 
•	Ability to multitask and physically fit
•	Process and results driven 
•	Team player; collaborative 
•	Resilient, patient and adaptable 
•	Enthusiastic, self-motivated 
•	Proactive & hard-working

Additional information:
•	Ability to work outside of normal business hours on occasion when delivering key orders. 
•	Ability to travel interstate, if required.

Job Description
We are looking for a seasoned and highly capable Senior Cyber Security Analyst to join our team. In this key role, you will be responsible for protecting the organisation’s systems, networks, and data against evolving cyber threats. Your deep knowledge of cyber security frameworks, risk management, incident response, and operational security will be essential in maintaining our security posture and meeting regulatory requirements. This is a great opportunity to take the lead on critical cyber security initiatives while guiding and mentoring junior team members.
Responsibilities:
Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive cyber security strategies and initiatives
Conduct regular security risk assessments, identify vulnerabilities, and recommend appropriate controls and countermeasures
Monitor and analyse security events, alerts, and logs to detect and respond to potential threats and breaches
Lead incident response efforts, including investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery, ensuring timely and effective resolution
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement secure infrastructure, systems, and applications
Conduct security assessments and penetration testing to identify and address vulnerabilities
Provide guidance and support in the development and implementation of security policies, standards, and procedures
Stay up to date with the latest cyber security threats, trends, and technologies, and recommend proactive measures to enhance our security posture
Mentor and provide guidance to junior members of the cyber security team, promoting professional growth and development
Ensure compliance with relevant industry regulations and frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR)
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
Must have at least 2 years of proven work experience as a Cyber Security Analyst, with a focus on security operations, incident response, and risk assessment
In-depth knowledge of cyber security principles, frameworks, and best practices
Experience with security monitoring tools, SIEM solutions, and threat intelligence platforms
Familiarity with penetration testing methodologies, vulnerability assessment tools, and secure coding practices
Strong understanding of network security, firewall configuration, intrusion detection systems, and endpoint protection
Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automation and security tool integration
Familiarity with cloud security principles and technologies (e.g., AWS, Azure)
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyse complex security issues and recommend effective solutions
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex security concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, or GIAC certifications are highly desirable
Proven leadership skills, with the ability to lead and mentor junior team members
Permanent Residents (PR) and Australian Citizens are eligible to apply
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $70,000 to $120,000 per year + super

Since 1995, VULCAN has been driven by a singular vision: to be Australasia’s most customer-focused and efficient metals distributor. By delivering superior service, we’ve grown from a carbon steel specialist into an industrial leader.

Today, we provide precision solutions across plate and coil processing, stainless, and engineering steels. With 69 world-class facilities and a team of 1,300+, our strategic expansion ensures we have the scale and expertise to keep the Australasian economy moving.

We are seeking experienced and qualified CNC PROGRAMMER to join our team of hardworking professionals. In this role, you will be responsible for preparing, developing, and optimising programs for Daito CNC Beam Lines and CNC Bandsaws to support accurate, efficient, and safe processing of steel sections.

Your key responsibilities include but will not be limited to:

CNC Programming
Generate CNC programs for Daito Beam Lines and CNC Bandsaws.
Import and prepare DSTV/NC1 files.
Validate machining features including drilling, marking, slotting, and cut lengths.
Apply correct tools, offsets, speeds, and feeds.
Optimise cutting and nesting sequences.
Conduct simulation checks.

Production Integration
Coordinate with schedulers and operators.
Prepare setup sheets and job packets.
Ensure part numbering and traceability as per customer specifications

Quality & Compliance
Verify programs match drawings and specifications.
Support first-off inspections.
Maintain version control.

Equipment & Process Support
Troubleshoot programming issues.

Continuous Improvement
Identify optimisation opportunities.
Maintain programming templates and macros.

Skills & Competencies

Technical Skills
Experience with Daito Beam Line programming and CNC Bandsaws.
Proficient with DSTV/NC1 and CAD/CAM workflows.
Ability to read engineering drawings.
Knowledge of steel profiles.

Professional Competencies:
High attention to detail
Strong problem-solving
Effective communication
Organised and reliable
Safety-focused

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Work location: DBR Carole Park
Salary: Between $75,000 and $85,000 per annum + Super

IKAD Engineering is a proud Western Australian private company with a national and international footprint. We provide a broad range of Project Management and Engineering solutions across a wide variety of Industry Sectors including Defence, Industrial, Mining, Marine, Oil & Gas, and Water Technology.

We are currently seeking applications for suitably qualified and experienced Trade Qualified Mechanical Fitters to join our friendly local team. 

The Role:

    Conduct overhauling of various mechanical units in the workshop or on site to a high standard and as specified
    Monitor the progress of project deliverables against required delivery dates
    Measure, calibrate and record mechanical sizes and equipment 
    Work in accordance with the company and client site HSEQ policies
    Complete and maintain project documentation (work instructions, test and inspections plans, task risk assessments and quality records.)
    2 year + Industry experience in a similar position
    Current ‘C’ Class Drivers licence
    Able to undergo extensive pre-employment medical and drug and alcohol screen
    Excellent Communication and Time Management skills
    Be able to work efficiently and independently with minimal supervision
    Strong work ethic with proven work history
    Positive and proactive approach to safety
    Willingness to work overtime
    Conduct equipment inspections to identify shortages, system defects and any other equipment issues 
    Be creative in your problem-solving approach 
    Complete work against strict deadlines and schedules

What you will bring to the team:

    Australian Recognised Trade qualification (Mechanical Fitter)
    White Card (essential)
    Punctuality, attention to detail ability to work to deadlines 

Desirable Criteria:

    Defence and/or Marine Industry experience
    Dogging and Rigging Ticket
    Confined Space & Working at Heights
    Forklift Ticket
    Elevated Work Platform
    ‘LR’ Class driver’s license

What we offer:

    Permanent, Full Time opportunity within a growing company
    Great annual salary of $80,000-$90,000 with overtime available
    A great team culture and working environment
    Exciting and unique projects 
    Ongoing Training and development
    Henderson Location, with occasional travel to site locations

If this sounds like the opportunity for you then APPLY NOW!

About the Role

JM Flooring Pty Ltd is looking for an experienced Flooring Installer to join our growing team.

This is a full-time position working on residential flooring projects across the Gold Coast, Northern NSW and Southern Brisbane.

Key Responsibilities

Install hybrid, laminate, engineered timber and solid hardwood flooring systems.
Install floating and direct-stick flooring systems.
Carry out subfloor preparation, including concrete grinding and floor levelling.
Install flooring to staircases, including stair nosings.
Install skirting boards and finishing trims.
Measure, cut and fit flooring materials accurately.
Complete flooring installations to a high standard.
Perform flooring repairs and replacements when required.
Maintain a clean, safe and organised worksite.
Follow all Work Health and Safety (WHS) requirements.
Skills & Experience

The successful applicant will have:

Experience installing hybrid, laminate, engineered timber and solid hardwood flooring.
Experience with floating and direct-stick flooring systems.
Experience in subfloor preparation, including concrete grinding and floor levelling.
Experience installing flooring to staircases, stair nosings and skirting boards.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Reliable, punctual and self-motivated.
Current Australian White Card.
Current Australian Driver Licence.
Willingness to travel to job sites across the Gold Coast, Northern NSW and Southern Brisbane.
1 Year minimum experience and qualification preferred
What We Offer

Full-time employment.
Competitive hourly rate of $80,000 –$85,000 per year, depending on experience.
Opportunity to work on a variety of residential flooring projects.
Supportive and professional team environment.
Long-term career opportunities.
Company tools and equipment provided.

Company car

Focuses on quality and workplace safety

Strong fault finding and independent problem-solving skills
Strong communication skills
Strong work ethic and values team work
